specimen_type: Tongue, right partial glossectomy with selective neck dissection

sections.Clinical details: 47-year-old man with a non-healing ulcer of the lateral border of the tongue and a long history of tobacco chewing. Right partial glossectomy with ipsilateral selective neck dissection (levels I-IV).
sections.Specimen:
1. Right partial glossectomy, lateral border of tongue.
2. Right selective neck dissection, levels I-IV.
sections.Gross description:
Specimen 1: partial glossectomy measuring 55 x 35 x 20 mm. An ulcerated, indurated lesion on the lateral border measures 28 mm in greatest dimension. The deep surface is inked. The cut surface is firm and greyish-white. The closest mucosal and deep margins are sectioned.
Specimen 2: neck dissection tissue in adipose tissue, with 24 lymph nodes identified. One node is firm and greyish-white. Nodes are submitted entirely.
sections.Microscopic description:
Sections show moderately differentiated keratinising squamous cell carcinoma infiltrating the lateral tongue, with keratin pearls and intercellular bridges. Depth of invasion is 7 mm. Perineural invasion is present. Lymphovascular invasion is not identified. Margins are free, with the closest mucosal margin 6 mm and the deep margin 5 mm.
Neck dissection: metastatic squamous cell carcinoma is present in one of 24 lymph nodes, with a deposit measuring 18 mm. Extranodal extension is absent.
sections.Diagnosis:
Right partial glossectomy: keratinising squamous cell carcinoma of the lateral tongue, moderately differentiated (G2), 28 mm, depth of invasion 7 mm, pT2. Margins free. Perineural invasion present. Lymphovascular invasion absent.
Right selective neck dissection (levels I-IV): metastatic squamous cell carcinoma in one of 24 lymph nodes, deposit 18 mm, no extranodal extension, pN1.
Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition): pT2 pN1, stage group III.
sections.Synoptic summary:
Tumour size: 28 mm
Histologic grade: G2 (moderately differentiated)
Margins: Free; closest mucosal margin 6 mm, deep margin 5 mm
Lymphovascular invasion: Absent
Perineural invasion: Present
Lymph nodes (positive/total): 1/24
pT: pT2
pN: pN1
Staging edition: AJCC 8th edition
sections.Comment: Single involved ipsilateral node with a deposit of 18 mm and no extranodal extension, together with perineural invasion. Adjuvant management should be discussed at the multidisciplinary tumour board.
